query:
SELECT LEAST(input_asset_id, output_asset_id)    AS "a!",
               GREATEST(input_asset_id, output_asset_id) AS "b!",
               COALESCE(SUM(sm.swap_usd(usd_value, output_usd_value)), 0) AS "volume!: BigDecimal"
        FROM sm.swaps
        WHERE block_timestamp > $1
        GROUP BY 1, 2
        ORDER BY 3 DESC, 1, 2
        LIMIT 1
